name: mujoco
description: MuJoCo physics simulation for robotics: writing and debugging MJCF models, importing URDF, simulating, controlling and rendering from Python, tuning contacts, and running batched GPU simulation. Use this skill when the user mentions MuJoCo, MJCF, mujoco.MjModel / MjData, mj_step, MjSpec, mujoco.Renderer, MUJOCO_GL, EGL/OSMesa headless rendering, the passive viewer or MuJoCo Studio, MuJoCo Menagerie (Franka, UR5e, SO-100/SO-101, ALOHA, G1), MJX, MuJoCo Warp (mujoco_warp), MuJoCo Playground, dm_control, or Gymnasium MuJoCo envs. Also trigger for contact tuning (solref, solimp, condim, friction, impratio, noslip), exploding or jittering simulations, objects sinking or grasps slipping, position actuator kp/kv, joint armature and damping, contype/conaffinity collision filtering, keyframes, integrator and timestep choice, and system identification or domain randomisation of MuJoCo model fields for sim-to-real.
